subject: general
question: What does 21 stand for in 'Agenda 21', a declaration aiming sustainable development adopted during Earth Summit 1992?
solution:
The correct answer is __**21st**____** century**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Agenda 21:__

 __
 
• Agenda 21 of the Rio Summit 1992 is related to Sustainable Development 
 
• United Nations Conference on Environment and Development(UNCED), also known as the Rio Summit
 
• It was held in Rio de Janeiro in June 1992
 
• The summit was convened for addressing the urgent problem of environmental protection and socio-economic development at the global level. 
 
• The Rio convention endorsed global forest principles and adopted agenda 21 for achieving sustainable development in the 21st century.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• UNDP:

 
 
• The United Nations Development Programme is an international organization that works to eradicate poverty while protecting the planet.
 
• UNDP works in about 170 countries and territories, helping to achieve the eradication of poverty and the reduction of inequalities and exclusion.
 
• They help countries to develop policies, leadership skills, partnering abilities, institutional capabilities, and build resilience in order to sustain development results.
 
• The headquarter of UNDP is in New York City.
 
 
 
• UNFPA:
 
 
• The United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) is a UN organization formerly known as United Nations Fund for Population Activities.
 
• Their work involves the improvement of reproductive health including the creation of national strategies and protocols, and providing supplies and services.
 
 
 
• UNODC:__
 __
 
• The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crimes (UNODC) has launched a ‘Lockdown Learners' series of online dialogues with students and educators in India__.
 
• The dialogue is on COVID-19 and its impact on Sustainable Development Goals, peace, and rule of law.
 
• The aim is to sensitize students on concerns of vulnerable groups and emerging issues such as cybercrime, misinformation, etc.
